record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Jolly Wristlet, Pink
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Jolly Wristlet is the perfect little accessory for adding a playful pop of texture and charm to your everyday look. Designed in vibrant tweeds and chic patterns with an oversized bow detail, this compact style delivers major personality in a petite silhouette. The detachable wristlet strap makes it easy to carry from coffee dates to holiday parties, while the top zip closure keeps your essentials secure on the go. Complete with one inner zip pocket and one inner slip pocket, the Jolly Wristlet keeps your must-haves organized in the cutest way possible.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Ellie Top Handle Bag, Red
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Ellie Top Handle Bag is the perfect mix of timeless glamour and modern charm. Designed with a luxe suede-like finish and a stunning pearl-accented chain handle, this bag instantly elevates any outfit from simple to standout. Its interchangeable straps let you switch effortlessly from a chic shoulder bag to a hands-free crossbody with the detachable chain strap. Complete with a magnetic closure and an inner zip pocket, the Ellie Top Handle Bag keeps your essentials stylishly secure wherever the day takes you.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Janis Cross-Body, Clay
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Janis Cross-Body/Wristlet is the perfect mix of boho charm and everyday versatility. Featuring playful fringe detailing, soft suede-inspired texture, and gleaming gold-tone chain accents, this compact bag makes a stylish statement wherever you go. Designed with interchangeable straps, it can be worn as a chic cross-body or carried as a wristlet for effortless day-to-night styling. A magnetic snap closure and inner zip pocket keep your essentials secure while you stay hands-free and fabulous.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Paige Hobo, Chocolate
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Paige Hobo is the sleek everyday shoulder bag that brings effortless style to any outfit. Designed with a softly structured silhouette and chic whipstitched trim, this bag adds just the right touch of texture and detail. A top zip closure keeps your essentials secure, while the interior zip pocket and dual slip pockets help keep everything neatly organized. Whether you choose classic black or rich chocolate brown, the Paige Hobo is ready to become your new daily favorite.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Roberta Tote, Taupe
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Roberta Tote is your new everyday carryall with a chic, relaxed twist. Featuring a soft suede-like finish and eye-catching braided double shoulder straps, this roomy tote blends effortless style with practical function. A magnetic snap closure keeps your essentials secure, while the outer slip pocket and inner slip pocket make staying organized easy on busy days. Whether you're heading to brunch, the office, or a weekend getaway, the Roberta Tote is ready to carry it all in style.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Danny Shoulder Bag, Brown
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Danny Shoulder Bag is the effortlessly cool carryall your everyday wardrobe has been craving. Featuring a soft slouchy silhouette, luxe suede-like texture, and chic knotted strap detail, this bag brings laid-back polish to any outfit. A single shoulder strap makes it easy to grab and go, while the top zip closure keeps your essentials secure all day long. Inside, the Danny Shoulder Bag is designed with one inner zip pocket and two slip pockets to keep everything perfectly organized in style.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Jet Convertible Cross-Body, Tan
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Jet Convertible Cross-Body is your new go-anywhere companion with a sporty-chic twist and plenty of personality. Designed with double top handles and an adjustable shoulder strap, this versatile bag easily switches from shoulder bag to cross-body style in a snap. Gold-tone hardware, colorful contrast details, and playful zipper pulls add an extra pop of fun to every outfit. With a top zip closure, multiple outer pockets, an inner zip pocket, and a built-in tech sleeve, the Jet Convertible Cross-Body keeps all your essentials stylishly organized from morning coffee runs to weekend adventures.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Paige Wristlet, Wine
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Paige Wristlet/Zip Pouch is the perfect blend of effortless style and everyday function. Designed in a soft suede-like finish with chic whipstitch detailing, this versatile pouch instantly elevates your daily essentials. Featuring a convenient wristlet strap, top zip closure, 1 outer magnetic snap pocket, 1 inner zip pocket, and 1 inner slip pocket, the Paige Wristlet/Zip Pouch keeps everything organized and close at hand. Whether you’re heading to brunch, date night, or running errands, this sleek accessory adds a polished finishing touch to any look.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Robbie Argyle Mini Tote, Pink
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Robbie Argyle Mini Tote packs plenty of personality into a perfectly petite silhouette with its cheerful oversized argyle pattern and colorful knit design. Crafted from washable polyester knit, this playful bag is made for everyday adventures while keeping your look effortlessly polished. Double top handles and a detachable, adjustable cross-body strap give you endless styling options whether you’re running errands or heading out for coffee dates. Complete with a removable polyester zip pouch for easy organization, the Robbie Argyle Mini Tote is small in size but big on charm.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Jolly Minaudiere, Black
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Jolly Minaudière is the ultimate party-ready accessory, bringing playful charm and polished glamour to every outfit. Featuring richly textured tweed fabrics in eye-catching patterns and festive colors, this chic clutch instantly elevates your look. A whimsical pearl and resin ball clasp adds a fun finishing touch, while the detachable cross-body chain lets you switch effortlessly from hands-free styling to an elegant handheld moment. Complete with a secure magnetic frame closure, the Jolly Minaudière is perfectly sized for your evening essentials and endless compliments.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Robbie Argyle Tote, Pink
record.Catalog_LongDescription: The Robbie Argyle Tote brings a playful pop of pattern to your everyday routine with its bold oversized argyle knit design and effortlessly chic silhouette. Crafted from washable polyester knit, this roomy tote is equal parts stylish and practical for workdays, weekend outings, and everything in between. Double shoulder straps and an easy tie closure make it comfortable to carry while keeping your essentials secure on the go. Finished with a detachable zip pouch for added organization, the Robbie Argyle Tote is the statement bag your wardrobe has been waiting for.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Jet Cross-Body, Olive
record.Catalog_LongDescription: Meet the Jet Cross-Body: compact, colorful, and ready for adventure. It features a top zip closure, one inner slip pocket, and an outer zip pocket for easy organization. The adjustable strap is detachable and comes with a removable eyeglasses pouch that snaps on for added convenience. With bold color-blocking and coordinating tassels, this cross-body is anything but basic.

parts.text:
I checked more closely, and JTV does have **bags**, along with new-to-you jewelry sets and watches. I pulled together a broad sample so you can see the range:

**Bag**  
Playful wristlets, convertible crossbody styles, and everyday carryalls. The [Jolly Wristlet, Pink](/product/1ZSS6C) is compact and organized, while the [Ellie Top Handle Bag, Red](/product/1WK47C) converts between top-handle, shoulder, and crossbody wear.

**Jewelry Set**  
Colorful crystal sets with coordinated pieces, including the [Purple & White Crystal Gold Tone Y-Necklace & Earring Set](/product/OPC2271) and a blue-and-white necklace, bracelet, and earring set.

**Wrist Watch**  
The collection also includes dress and casual directions, from a brown leather-band watch to a stainless-steel style with 100-meter water resistance.

The bag selection is the strongest match for your earlier question about purses.

Designed with a luxe suede-like finish and a stunning pearl-accented chain handle, this bag instantly elevates any outfit from simple to standout. Its interchangeable straps let you switch effortlessly from a chic shoulder bag to a hands-free crossbody with the detachable chain strap. Complete with a magnetic closure and an inner zip pocket, the Ellie Top Handle Bag keeps your essentials stylishly secure wherever the day takes you.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Mimi Pink Credit Card Holder with Wristlet
record.Catalog_LongDescription: Whether shopping on the Kings Road, London, or meeting friends for coffee on the Boulevard St Germain, Mimi is the chic, sleek accessory for the woman on-the-go. Mimi is adorable, versatile and all you need. Each of the statement pieces works individually or can be clasped together and slipped over the wrist, slung over the shoulder or held neatly around the waist.

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Michael Kors Reed Large Belted Leather Tote Handbag in Exotic Embossed Oxblood
record.Catalog_LongDescription: With its belted silhouette and roomy interior, the Reed tote is a chic companion any time of year. It has plenty of room to carry everything you need, and includes interior zip and slip pockets for storing smaller items. The clean lines and practical design of the bag allow for effortless styling. Dimensions are 17"(Top) 13"(Bottom) (L)x 11"(H) x 6"(D).

record.Catalog_TitleDescription: Michael Kors Katya Medium Flap Crossbody Handbag in Faux Embossed Croc Patent Deer
record.Catalog_LongDescription: This wear-everywhere crossbody bag strikes the perfect balance between fashion and function. The logo-print exterior delivers signature appeal, while a back slip pocket and open interior offer plenty of storage for smaller essentials. Detach the strap to carry it in hand as a pouch. Dimensions are 10.5" x 2.5" x 4.5".

parts.text:
Fair call, those were deeply unexciting. Let’s try the **interesting** shelf instead:

**Brooch**  
Unexpected and conversation-starting: a green chrome diopside brooch with an enhancer function, or a playful jack-o’-lantern design.

**Pendant**  
The [Ethiopian Opal Pendant](/product/WPG153) has documented play-of-color with blue and white diamond accents. For something more geometric, the [Strontium Titanate & Pink Moissanite Pendant](/product/WPD973) brings an Asscher-cut look with a pink accent stone.

**Bag**  
The [Cream Leopard Calf-Hair Wristlet Wallet](/product/1ZV34A) is much more distinctive than a basic pouch, while the [Bugatti Henry Backpack](/product/1ZKKAA) adds practical interest with a laptop compartment and luggage pass-through.

This is more “tell me about that” and less “I’ve seen it at every department store.”

parts.text:
Now we’re talking. Brooches here range from collectible-feeling gemstone pieces to playful, wearable conversation starters.

**Material: Gold Over Silver**  
For sparkle with a more polished finish, the [Strontium Titanate & Lab-Created Sapphire Brooch](/product/WPD590) is an unusual stone combination, while the [Judith Ripka Bella Luce Bow Brooch](/product/JRJ968) takes a more glamorous, recognizable direction.

**Material: Silver**  
The [Chrome Diopside Brooch with Enhancer](/product/RST1116) is the standout for versatility because it can also function as an enhancer. The [Chrome Diopside Flower Brooch](/product/RST1093) adds natural green stones with citrine and a diamond accent.

**Material: Base Metal**  
For maximum personality, the [Hummingbird Brooch Pendant](/product/OPJ609) can be worn as either a brooch or pendant. There’s also a [Hummingbird Brooch and Earring Set](/product/OPC908) with multicolor, mixed-shape crystal details.

My most interesting picks are the hummingbird pendant-brooch for versatility and the chrome diopside enhancer for a less predictable gemstone story.
